about: What people have built from or alongside TfL's axonometric station diagrams (FOI, 2015 and later), as a baseline for 3D station modelling in magpie/cwplans. Links and facts only: no third-party model or image is copied.
method: web search, direct fetches where robots.txt allows, Sketchfab API v3, GitHub search and raw files, ArcGIS Hub API, HTTP HEAD on foi.tfl.gov.uk, and the local OSM extract (osmfr-greater-london, 2026-10-01T01:43:50Z) read with osmium

licence_classes.open: an open licence (CC BY, OGL, TfL open data terms, ODbL, GPL); share_alike true marks ODbL, CC BY-SA, GPL and BY-NC-SA
licence_classes.restricted: all rights reserved, non-commercial, paid, or FOI/RPSI re-use only

relations.used as reference: the sheets were read but not copied

not_read.why: robots.txt disallows Claude-Web, ClaudeBot, Claude-SearchBot, Claude-User
robots.txt disallows Claude-Web, ClaudeBot and anthropic-ai
HTTP 403 to the fetch tool (not retried)

entries.title: Axonometric diagrams - London Underground Stations (FOI request, 2015 release of 124 sheets)
entries.author: Georges Vehres (requester); Transport for London (author of the drawings)
stations: all 124 "section 12" LU stations A to W
entries.format: raster drawings (JPEG/PDF), not to scale, partly redacted
entries.downloadable: yes (from WhatDoTheyKnow by hand; scripts get a Cloudflare challenge)
entries.licence_as_stated: "Copyright of the diagrams is owned by TfL. If you would like to re-use the information please contact TfL." (quoted by Ian Visits; RPSI Regulations 2005)
entries.quality: Section 12 (King's Cross fire) fire-brigade location guides; labels, escalator and lift numbers, levels; steep vertical exaggeration; redaction blobs
entries.usefulness_reason: The baseline itself. The owner approved use of the TfL sheets (2026-10-05); Canada Water and Canary Wharf are held in londat/third_party/tfl/am3d/.
entries.read_status: not read: WhatDoTheyKnow answers scripts with a Cloudflare challenge

entries.title: OpenStreetMap indoor mapping of Canada Water station (Simple Indoor Tagging)
entries.author: mostly OSM user Weltstaat (425 of the indoor/level elements, 2018); later 小智智, DaveF and others (2024-2026)
entries.format: OSM: indoor=yes 107, indoor=corridor 18, indoor=room 3, indoor=door 5, highway=corridor 12, steps 13; Jubilee platforms level -3 (w437217009, w568126849), Windrush line platforms level -2 (r8095040, r8095041); intermediate levels such as -0.3, -0.7, -2.3, -2.7 on ramps and stairs

entries.title: OpenStreetMap indoor and level mapping at Canary Wharf (Jubilee line station and DLR)
